description: With Seedance 2.5, you can take real footage and change individual parts of the video while keeping everything else intact. In this test, I changed clothing colors, replaced my entire outfit, rebuilt the environment, redesigned and removed objects, and even changed the weather from rain to snow. Inside Runway, you can edit clips up to 30 seconds, use Sketch to select exactly what you want to change, or simply describe the edit and add reference images when needed. Seedance 2.5 is now available alongside models like Gen-4.5, Flux 3, Kling 3.0 and more. Sign up to Runway today through my page and get 50% off 1 month of any Runway plan using code SEEDANCE50. #madewithrunway #seedance25 #runway #aivideoediting #aivideo
